title: Repeat String
description:
Write code that enhances all strings such that you can call the `string.replicate(x)` method on any string and it will return repeated string `x` times.

Try to implement it without using the built-in method `string.repeat`.
hints: Analyze the constraints and data structures appropriate for Repeat String.
Formulate an optimal state transition or traversal invariant.
Consider corner testcases and boundary limits.
